title: a standalone grid's authored $filter on a field withheld by a disabled package still answers 400 — #34979 fixes only the list view's grid (follow-up of #34901)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #32588, 6963320315), from the seat's L2 on PR #34979 (6963280774). That review found #34901's failure class live on other surfaces: a view or definition naming a field that a disabled package withholds. The review read code and ran nothing on these, so this card is **reading first**.

Follow-up of #34901 (p1; HotCRM's next release waits on it). The view-type bindings are already #34989.

## Question
A standalone grid (a page block, not the list view) whose authored `$filter` names a withheld field: confirm it still answers 400 while the package is off, and drop or neutralise the withheld clause the way #34979 does for the list view's grid.

Done when a live reading (a package P extends an object with a field, a definition in Q names that field, P disabled) answers the question, and the fix is made or filed with its own grade.

Grade: **p1 · domain:ui**. Theme: HotCRM usable, with a named effect. It is the same failure #34901 fixes, a whole grid failing with 400 when a package is off, on the remaining grid surface. The code read is concrete, so the reading here is confirmation before the fix.
